The hook
01

17 years of racing. India's biggest cycling club.

Bangalore Bicycle Championships

India's largest and most reputed cycling club and championship — racing since 2009.

Nandi Epic is run by BBCh — Bangalore Bicycle Championships, Bengaluru's home of competitive cycling and India's longest-running race club.

Since 2009 we have built the biggest, most credible racing community in the country — road races, MTB and cross-country, time trials and criteriums, from under-9s to Masters. The Nandi Hills time trial and the Bangalore Classic are on every serious rider's calendar.

17years of racing
3,150+riders on record
84events run
7,200+results logged
